findings.title: Auto-condense summarizer stream inside attemptApiRequest is unbounded and can still hang a worker
findings.fix: Default (a): bound summarizeConversation's stream with awaitWithStreamTimeout (first_chunk: getApiRequestTimeout, between_chunks: getApiStreamIdleTimeout), pass a local AbortController signal as abortSignal and abort it on timeout; the existing catch falls back to truncation. Add condense/index.ts to Files changed, an A5 row, and a fake-timer condense test. Alternative (b): document as unbounded in A5 and backlog, and remove the 'close every indefinite wait' claim.

findings.title: failWorkerIfRetriesExhausted counts cancellations as API failures
findings.fix: First line: if (!this.parallelWorker || this.abort) return false. Add a test that an aborted worker at counter 8 gets no parallelWorkerFailure.

findings.title: OmniRoute upstream cancellation on client disconnect is unverified
findings.fix: Add V7 with a live check that aborting from Zoo drops the 5090 reader's active-slot count.

findings.title: Between-chunk timeout after tools have already executed retries the turn (possible duplicate side effects) without being stated
findings.location: A3 On timeout; Error handling summary (A)
findings.fix: Document as accepted, matching today's mid-stream-failure semantics; no code change.

findings.title: didToolFailInCurrentTurn unspecified for B2 row 1 and the B1 nudge
findings.fix: B2 row 1 sets didToolFailInCurrentTurn = true (matching sibling error branches); the B1 nudge does not. Assert it in the 'just prose' test.
